title: Harness Descriptor (harness.json)
description: Machine-readable statement of a project's commands, paths and harness version. Read by the Runtime hooks, init.sh, and the scaffold.

harness_version.description: Version of the harness templates this project was scaffolded from (semver).

verify.description: Baseline verification (typecheck, tests, lint); run by init.sh.

start.description: Dev server / app start; printed by init.sh, run with RUN_START_COMMAND=1.

format.description: Formatter for one file; {file} is replaced with the edited path. Omit to disable the format hook.

test.description: Narrow test loop for TDD; optional.

requires.description: Tool version gates checked by init.sh before installing. Keys are executables; values are semver ranges (>=, ^, exact).

agents_md.description: Also maintain an AGENTS.md pointer for non-Claude agents.
